--- a/minbpe/base.py
+++ b/minbpe/base.py
@@ -22,2 +22,3 @@
-_VOCAB_BYTES_PREFIX_CACHE = None
-_MODEL_BYTES_PREFIX_CACHE = None
+_VOCAB_BYTES_PREFIX_CACHE = None
+_MODEL_BYTES_PREFIX_CACHE = None
+_BUILD_VOCAB_PREFIX_CACHE = None

--- a/minbpe/base.py
+++ b/minbpe/base.py
@@ -149,8 +149,22 @@
-    def _build_vocab(self):
-        # vocab is simply and deterministically derived from merges
-        vocab = BYTE_VOCAB.copy()
-        for (p0, p1), idx in self.merges.items():
-            vocab[idx] = vocab[p0] + vocab[p1]
-        for special, idx in self.special_tokens.items():
-            vocab[idx] = special.encode("utf-8")
-        return vocab
+    def _build_vocab(self):
+        # vocab is simply and deterministically derived from merges
+        global _BUILD_VOCAB_PREFIX_CACHE
+        merge_items = tuple(self.merges.items())
+        prefix_len = 0
+        cached_prefix = _BUILD_VOCAB_PREFIX_CACHE
+        if cached_prefix is not None:
+            cached_merge_items, cached_vocab = cached_prefix
+            if (len(cached_merge_items) <= len(merge_items)
+                    and merge_items[:len(cached_merge_items)] == cached_merge_items):
+                prefix_len = len(cached_merge_items)
+                vocab = cached_vocab.copy()
+            else:
+                vocab = BYTE_VOCAB.copy()
+        else:
+            vocab = BYTE_VOCAB.copy()
+        for (p0, p1), idx in merge_items[prefix_len:]:
+            vocab[idx] = vocab[p0] + vocab[p1]
+        _BUILD_VOCAB_PREFIX_CACHE = (merge_items, vocab.copy())
+        for special, idx in self.special_tokens.items():
+            vocab[idx] = special.encode("utf-8")
+        return vocab
